_comment: The artifact view-link shape the hosted MCP server is tested against. Read by tests/Feature/McpContractTest.php (App\Services\Artifacts\ArtifactViewLink) so the field name and which link a tier gets cannot drift. `ephemeral` is the anonymous expiring tier deploy_to_canvas publishes: the Worker serves it to anyone, so it is the raw URL like public.
_deploy_to_canvas_comment: deploy_to_canvas publishes an anonymous KV record and no workspace row, so the app's open route — which resolves content from D1 — can only 404 for it, and a server-side redirect cannot carry the decryption fragment the KV preview shell requires. Every tier it accepts therefore gets the Worker's own URL with that fragment: the app route is not a fallback for this tool, it is structurally unable to work. deploy_artifact and get_artifact keep the tier rule above.
